svg.aria-label: Survey bulletin: AEMDREEQUOX MINOR, class: Chrome Sea. Inhabitants: an unknown number of librarian eels who migrate north once per century, then apologise. Advisory: Landing is permitted. Leaving is under review.
svg.title: AEMDREEQUOX MINOR — Outer Survey Office bulletin No. 7
svg.text: FORM PS-7 · DAILY PLANETARY BULLETIN · No. 7
An unknown number of librarian eels who migrate
north once per century, then apologise.
The planet is hollow, and the inside is nicer.
⚠ Landing is permitted. Leaving is under
“Several crew members have asked to stay. They
seem happy. We are not sure.” — Field Surveyor
